title: Incident to Trauma-Grade Reflex (T2 howto)
desc: T2 howto: the 2-layer procedure for turning a fixed incident into a trauma-grade reflex -- capture knowledge in a wkappbot skill, then wire a CLAUDE.md Emergency Reflexes row, then verify. Includes the skill contribute --requirement gotcha.
steps: LAYER 1 (knowledge): after confirming+fixing, run 'wkappbot skill edit <relevant-skill> --add-step "<symptom>: root cause + fix commit + detection + verify"' (English only). Use the emergency/domain skill as home (e.g. wkdr-emergency-doctor-... for storms).

LAYER 2 (reflex): edit the repo CLAUDE.md '⚡ Emergency Reflexes' table -- add a row 'symptom | immediate action NOW (e.g. ! wkdr nuke) | skill-id'. The action must be runnable in one shot, no investigation.
POSTERITY: the knowledge MUST sit in a wkappbot SKILL (cross-repo, inherited via skill read/search); the CLAUDE.md row is only a fast local pointer to it.
VERIFY: re-trigger or simulate the symptom and confirm the reflex action resolves it; otherwise the reflex is unproven.

CONTRIBUTE GOTCHA: 'wkappbot skill contribute' REQUIRES --requirement (>=1 'cmd => expected') ALONGSIDE --app/--id/--title/--desc/--step. Omitting --requirement saves a draft + exits 1 with a vague 'missing fields' message (the missing field IS --requirement). Re-run WITH --requirement -> it loads the draft and creates. (Not a draft-only bug; just a poor error message.)
